bioschemas.name: BSM-Arc
bioschemas.summary: The Biological Structure Model Archive (BSM-Arc) aims to collect raw data obtained via in silico methods related to structural biology, such as computationally modeled 3D structures and molecular dynamics trajectories. Since BSM-Arc does not enforce a specific data format for the raw data, depositors are free to upload their data without any prior conversion. Besides uploading raw data, BSM-Arc enables depositors to annotate their data with additional explanations and figures. It is possible to recreate 3D scenes as shown in the corresponding scientific article in an interactive manner.
